mode: Isolated local production browser, HTTP/Realtime fixtures; no Supabase writes or real service load test

results.scenario: Four independent browser contexts load the same active auction and become live
1,000 bids / 2,000 shuffled duplicated notifications per view appear before two-second stale snapshots finish
After stale responses: presentation shows only 12 current winners without amounts; full 300-person bidder ranking and latest 500 admin history rows agree
Another 1,000 bids in a sustained stream: all views converge, no overlapping protected reads, same 12 winners
600 consecutive bids by one participant: older winning bidders remain ranked and the admin donation total includes winners absent from its 500 recent rows
Both real bidder forms accept identical €50 bids below the €500 opening price and leader; a €0.01 follow-up is also saved while personal bests and all rankings remain unchanged
A real bidder form accepts €8,000 above the old maximum increase; all four views update to the new leader, presentation still hides amounts
A missed live notification is repaired from the common server snapshot in all four views
Two winning places show exactly two names, with no remaining Top 10 rows or currency values
Elapsed visual timer keeps amounts hidden and bidding open until the administrator ends the event
Realtime winner-count update expands presentation to exactly 15 winners without amounts
Event end reveals each winner's amount in the presentation leaderboard, disables both bidder forms and survives older active snapshots
Live names and final amounts fit desktop, 16:9 slide and mobile layouts without horizontal overflow
An unsaved new-event form remains selected during unrelated live traffic
